reasoning.step1:
1) Determine if document is an invoice:
- Contains invoice indicators: "Rechn.Nr.", "Datum:", "Netto 10% Ust. Brutto", line items with net/vat/brutto, "Endsaldo EUR 506,73", payment/IBAN details. No prominent exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") in header. Conclusion: classify as invoice.

2) Locate Grand Total:
- Found "Endsaldo EUR 506,73" and repeated "506,73" in payment section. Extract GrandTotal.Amount = 506,73 → convert to numeric 506.73 (preserving two decimals).

3) Locate Invoice Date:
- Found "Datum: 23.1.2024" (appears twice). Preserve format as string "23.1.2024".

4) Locate Sender VAT ID:
- Found "UID: ATU36768002" near footer. Extract Sender.VatId = "ATU36768002".

5) Identify VAT groups and amounts:
- Header shows "Netto 10% Ust. Brutto".
- Line items:
  - Abfallwirtschaftsgebühr: Netto 309,05 ; Ust. 30,90 ; Brutto 339,95
  - Kanalbenützungsgebühr: Netto 151,62 ; Ust. 15,16 ; Brutto 166,78
- Both groups use 10% VAT. Per instructions, combine exchange/applicable VAT groups for entire invoice.
- Sum Net.Amount = 309,05 + 151,62 = 460,67 → numeric 460.67 (two decimals).
- Sum Vat.Amount = 30,90 + 15,16 = 46,06 → numeric 46.06 (two decimals).
- Vat.Rate = 10 (extract without %).

6) Verify consistency:
- Net 460.67 + Vat 46.06 = 506.73 matches GrandTotal.Amount 506.73. All values consistent.

7) No inference beyond visible data:
- All extracted fields come directly from text. If any field had been missing, would be left empty.
